# OneHand Sales

OneHand Sales, also branded in Korean as 한손에 영업, is a personal and field sales CRM for people who manage customers, business cards, meetings, schedules, proposals, deals, and follow-up work directly.

Canonical site: https://www.onehandsales.com/ko

Primary positioning:
- Personal sales CRM
- Field sales CRM
- B2B sales CRM for small and midsize businesses
- Real estate agent CRM
- Customer follow-up and sales schedule management software
- Lightweight CRM for individual salespeople, consultants, agencies, and relationship-based sellers

Primary audience:
- Individual salespeople
- SMB B2B salespeople
- Field and outside sales professionals
- Real estate agents and assistant agents
- Industrial, machinery, parts, raw material, medical device, pharmaceutical, trade, import/export, wholesale, IT service, and SI salespeople
- Insurance agents, financial advisors, and car salespeople
- Headhunters and recruiting consultants
- Advertising agency, software agency, and franchise sales teams
- Education salespeople and corporate training salespeople
- Tax accountants, labor consultants, patent attorneys, legal scriveners, freelancers, consultants, and solo agencies
- Wedding, interior design, event, travel, study abroad, and immigration consultants who manage repeated customer consultations and follow-up

Core product areas:
- Company, account, customer, client, and contact management
- Lead and prospect management
- Product, proposal, quote, contract, and deal pipeline tracking
- Schedule, visit, revisit, meeting, and follow-up management
- Meeting notes and sales activity records
- Business card scanning and business card OCR
- Follow-up reminders and notification workflows
- Search across companies, contacts, deals, schedules, notes, and sales records
- Sales and marketing follow-up management
- Personal customer ledger for sellers who do not want to depend on a company-owned CRM
